narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Kimai, Recognised at a Glance"**

time-keep is laid out and dressed like Kimai, the tool its one user already knows: a near-black sidebar on the PC with a blue bar on the current screen, a white header carrying the screen's title and the running timer, near-white ground under white surfaces, neutral cool greys, Public Sans throughout. There is no themed concept over the tool. The visual job is recognition and a timer that is visible and stoppable from every screen.

Colour is held back for meaning. One blue marks what is running and the one primary action; red marks only what is irregular or destructive; everything else is neutral grey. The one strong colour in the system belongs to the projects: each project gets one of eight colours and that colour follows its time everywhere it appears. Rank comes from weight, size and thin rules, not from panels or shadow.

It is a working tool, dense on the PC and thumb-sized on the phone. It refuses the grey SaaS dashboard of stat tiles.
keyCharacteristics: Kimai's frame: a 232 px near-black sidebar, a 60 px white header, the screen on a near-white ground.
One blue for running and primary; red only for irregular or destructive; neutral greys.
Eight project colours, each with an edge, a tinted fill and a readable ink, assigned by creation order.
Public Sans, tabular figures for every time, date and duration.
4 px corners (6 px on the entry dialog and sheet), 1 px rules, no shadows except on floating sheets, popovers, the dialog and a calendar block lifted in a drag.
150 ms ease-out colour changes on state only; the elapsed time ticks in place.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue means running or the primary action, and focus (and, on the phone, where you are: the current bottom-bar cell and More row). It is never decoration, never a heading, never an icon tint beyond that current cell. A property of a row is not running: a template's TIMER mark is muted, with a timer icon, never blue.

rules.name: The Red Means Wrong Rule
rules.body: Red appears only for something irregular or destructive. A running timer is blue, never red.

rules.name: The Project Ink Rule
rules.body: A project is one colour, used identically wherever its time appears. Today the timer dot, the start list, Fill from, the project picker, the Calendar (block edge, fill and ink, month dots, the phone day list's bar) and Entries (the table's 8 px dot, the project chip's dot, the phone row's 4 px bar) use it, and so do Today's template rows and entries, the Templates table and list (an 8 px dot before the name; none without a project), Setup's project rows (the dot at 50 % when archived) and Reports' Projects list (an 8 px dot before the customer › project). Copy-out's sheet is the copied text and carries no dot. No other element borrows a project colour.

rules.name: The Text-Colour Marks Rule
rules.body: In the Calendar, what only points is in the text colour: the line at now and its tag, today's circle, the chosen day's ring, a drag's landing tag. Blue and red already mean running and wrong; these marks never borrow them. The Filter's count badge is such a mark: it counts, so it is a text-colour pill, never blue.

rules.name: The Figures Rule
rules.body: Every time, date and duration is set in `figures`. Columns never move.

rules.name: The Six Steps Rule
rules.body: The ramp is 12, 13, 14, 15, 17 and 21 px. No other size on working screens. 13 px is only the hint step, small helper text under or after a field or a row's title.

rules.name: The Caps Are Heads Rule
rules.body: `caps` sets a column head, a section head (which is the heading itself, an h2 on a rule), a group head in a list, a badge, a state label or a template's mark. Never a kicker above a heading.

rules.name: The Floating Only Rule
rules.body: A surface at rest has no shadow. Only a sheet, popover or dialog that floats over the page casts one, and a calendar block only while it is lifted in a drag.

dos: **Do** keep the shell recognisably Kimai's: the near-black sidebar with a blue bar on the current item, the 60 px white header, the near-white ground.
**Do** use #262626 for the rail in light and #0f0f10 in dark, with the phone strip a step off the top bar (`sidebar-strip`: darker in light, lighter in dark).
**Do** keep one blue primary button per form; outline buttons for the rest.
**Do** carry a project's colour everywhere its time appears, from the creation-order palette, and nowhere else.
**Do** set every time, date and duration in `figures`.
**Do** keep 44 px targets on the phone and the navigation inside thumb reach.
**Do** open an entry's form in place: a dialog on the PC, a sheet on the phone, with Cancel and Save always on screen.
**Do** keep every control at a phone screen's right edge out of the "+"'s column.
**Do** keep motion to 150 ms ease-out colour changes on state, removed under reduced motion.
**Do** mark now, today, the chosen day and a drag's landing in the text colour.
**Do** draw a calendar block in its project's fill, edge and ink, with red only for an overlap and blue only for running or a new entry.
**Do** give Customer › project room to read in full: a fixed 224 px column in the PC table, two lines on a phone row.
**Do** fill every ticked row with `accent`, not only its box.
**Do** show a phone choice over the page as a native modal bottom sheet over the scrim, closed by Escape, the scrim and Back, with its primary action pinned in view.
**Do** stroke every checkbox with `checkbox` and keep `input` for fields and buttons.
**Do** mark a template by what a tap does, TIMER or LOG, in muted `caps`, TIMER with its timer icon.
**Do** let a phone row's meta line wrap between its parts, keeping a reference such as "T-1234" whole.
**Do** mark an on toggle chip by fill, weight and a check together (`accent`, semibold, the check), never by colour alone, and keep the off chip's `checkbox` outline.
**Do** let a copied table fit by wrapping Description, keeping short values on one line, and scroll the panel sideways only when the columns cannot fit.
**Do** mark a part that needs the script `data-js` and a no-script-only part `data-nojs`, both drawn by the server.
**Do** return focus after an action: to Undo after a done change, to the head tick box or Select after a clear (when in view; else to the last ticked row, never scrolling the page).
donts: **Don't** use blue or red for decoration, headings or icons, beyond the current bottom-bar cell's blue icon; red is never the running state.
**Don't** store a project's colour or let anything but a project use the project palette.
**Don't** give a surface at rest a shadow; only floating sheets, popovers and dialogs, and a calendar block while lifted in a drag, cast one.
**Don't** add text sizes beyond 12, 13, 14, 15, 17 and 21 px on working screens.
**Don't** set `caps` as a kicker or eyebrow above a heading.
**Don't** build stat-tile dashboards or put a themed concept over the tool.
**Don't** colour a template's TIMER mark blue; blue is for the timer that is running.
**Don't** cut a project to one line on the phone or let a pinned foot scroll out of a sheet.
